pathways.label: Home school as private school — Leeper exemption
pathways.legalBasis: Texas Education Code §25.086; Leeper v. Arlington ISD, 897 S.W.2d 948 (Tex. 1994); Homeschool Freedom Act of 2025, HB 2674

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: No minimum days or hours required under Texas law

requiredSubjects.notes: Per Leeper v. Arlington ISD; curriculum must be bona fide and in written form covering these five subjects

filings.notes: No notice of intent, no registration, no state approval required. If withdrawing from public school, parent provides written notice to the district only; no state form required.

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: §1002.41 explicitly excludes home education from public school day requirements; no minimum days specified

requiredSubjects.notes: §1002.41 specifies no mandatory subjects; parent selects curriculum

value.deadline: Within 30 days of establishing the home education program
value.content: Written notice signed by parent including full legal names, addresses, and birthdates of all children in the program
value.notes: Also required within 30 days of moving to a new district, adding a child, or terminating the program

value.calendarDeadlineNotes: Statute requires annual evaluation but specifies no fixed calendar deadline; tied to the program year
methods: Nationally normed student achievement test administered by a certified teacher
Evaluation by a licensed psychologist or school psychologist
Any other valid measurement tool mutually agreed upon by parent and superintendent

value.portfolioContents: Log of educational activities made contemporaneously with instruction designating reading materials by title; samples of writings, worksheets, workbooks, or creative materials
value.availableForInspection: Upon 15 days written notice from superintendent; inspection is not mandatory

pathways.label: Home Instruction
pathways.legalBasis: 8 NYCRR §100.10 (Commissioner's Regulations); New York Education Law §3204

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: Instruction must be 'the substantial equivalent of 180 days each school year'

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: 900 hours for grades 1–6; 990 hours for grades 7–12. One unit = 6,480 minutes of instruction per school year.

grades9to12: social studies (4 units including American history, Participation in Government, Economics)

value.deadline: July 1 annually; or within 14 days of commencing home instruction mid-year
Within 4 weeks of receiving district forms, or August 15 — whichever is later
value.content: Syllabi, curriculum materials, textbooks, or plan of instruction per required subject; names of instructors; dates of quarterly report submissions

value.deadline: On dates specified in IHIP, spaced at even intervals throughout the year
value.content: Cumulative instruction hours, materials covered per subject, grades or narrative evaluations; explanation if less than 80% of planned coursework completed

value.filingTiming: Submitted with or as part of the 4th quarterly report
value.passingStandard: Composite score above 33rd percentile on national norms OR demonstration of one year of academic growth
methods: Nationally normed standardized test: Iowa Test of Basic Skills, California Achievement Test, Stanford Achievement Test, Comprehensive Test of Basic Skills, or Metropolitan Achievement Test
Written narrative evaluation by a NYS-certified teacher (grades 1–3 annually; grades 4–8 every other year as alternative)
value.administrationNote: Test may be administered at a public school, registered/nonregistered nonpublic school, or at home by a certified teacher

value.attendanceRecords: Maintained by parent; available to district upon request
value.quarterlyReports: Filed with district per IHIP schedule

recordRetention.notes: Regulation does not specify a minimum post-program retention duration

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: Must provide instruction substantially equivalent to public school; specific day/hour minimums for home-operated nonpublic school not separately codified in §3204(2)

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: Substantial equivalence standard applies; specific hours not separately codified for this pathway

requiredSubjects.notes: Must provide substantially equivalent instruction to public school curriculum; subject list not separately enumerated for this pathway in §3204(2)

filings.notes: IHIP and quarterly report requirements of §100.10 do not apply; district may conduct a substantial equivalence review; specific filing obligations not confirmed

evaluationOrTesting.notes: No standardized testing requirement codified under this pathway; district may initiate substantial equivalence review

recordRetention.notes: Not separately specified for this pathway

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: 180 days OR the equivalent hours alternative satisfies the requirement

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: Elementary (grades K–6): 180 days OR 900 hours. Secondary (grades 7–12): 180 days OR 990 hours. Either standard satisfies the law.

elementary: history of the United States and Pennsylvania

value.deadline: Prior to commencement of program; then annually by August 1
value.recipient: Superintendent of the school district of residence
value.content: Supervisor name, child name/age/address/phone; assurance subjects taught in English; outline of proposed objectives by subject area; immunization records; medical records; compliance assurance; criminal history certification for all adults residing in the home (no disqualifying offenses within past 5 years)

evaluatorQualifications: Non-public school teacher or administrator with at least 2 years teaching experience within the last 10 years
value.evaluationBasis: Interview of child and review of portfolio
value.standardizedTestingNote: At grades 3, 5, and 8: PSSAs or an approved nationally normed standardized test in reading/language arts and mathematics must be included in the portfolio

value.portfolioContents: Contemporaneous log designating reading materials by title; samples of writings, worksheets, workbooks, or creative materials used or developed by the student
value.durationNotes: Statute requires portfolio maintained during the program; no explicit post-program minimum retention duration specified

pathways.label: Home-based private school (Private School Affidavit) — includes PSP/umbrella enrollment

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: EC §48222 specifies no minimum school days for home-based private schools; private schools set their own calendars

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: No minimum hours specified under this pathway

grades1to6: English (reading, literature, language, composition, spelling, handwriting)

requiredSubjects.notes: EC §48222 requires instruction 'in the several branches of study required to be taught in the public schools of the state', referencing EC §51210 (grades 1–6) and EC §51220 (grades 7–12). PSPs (Private School Satellite Programs / umbrella schools) operate under this same statutory framework — the PSP files the affidavit; legal requirements for the parent are identical.

value.recipient: Superintendent of Public Instruction (filed online via CDE Private School Affidavit system)
value.content: All business names and addresses, enrollment by grade, teacher count, faculty names/addresses/qualifications, confirmation of required records maintenance

filings.notes: Filing the PSA is explicitly non-evaluative — EC §33190 states it shall not be construed as evaluation, recognition, approval, or endorsement by the state

evaluationOrTesting.notes: No state-mandated testing or evaluation required

value.attendanceNote: Must record every absence of a pupil for half a day or more throughout the school year
value.facultyNote: Names, addresses, and educational qualifications of all faculty
value.durationNotes: EC §48222 and §33190 require maintenance of records but do not specify a minimum retention duration

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: EC §48224 specifies 175 days per calendar year; marked unverified because the statute text was not directly fetched — verify against current statute before relying on this value

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: EC §48224 specifies 3 hours per day minimum (not an annual total); 175 days × 3 hrs = 525 hrs implied minimum — verify against current statute

instructionHoursPerDay.notes: EC §48224 minimum; verify against current statute text

requiredSubjects.value: Same branches of study required to be taught in public schools (references EC §51210/§51220)
requiredSubjects.notes: Tutor must hold a valid California state credential for the grade level being taught

tutorQualification.value: Valid California state credential for the grade level being taught

filings.notes: No affidavit or district notification required under EC §48224

recordRetention.notes: EC §48224 does not specify record retention; unclear whether general private school record rules apply — verify

pathways.label: Public school independent study program
pathways.legalBasis: California Education Code §46300.6; EC §51745 et seq.

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: Child remains enrolled in public school; attendance requirements governed by the written independent study agreement with the district

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: Hours governed by written IS agreement; varies by district program

requiredSubjects.notes: Curriculum follows public school requirements; determined by district IS agreement

value.content: Learning objectives, course of study, materials, evaluation method, minutes of instruction per day
value.notes: Terms vary by district; statute requires written agreement but content is district-defined
Student participates in all state assessments as a public school student; district evaluates work product per IS agreement terms

evaluationOrTesting.notes: Specific requirements vary by district IS program

recordRetention.notes: Records maintained by district; parent retains copies per IS agreement

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: MCL §380.1561(3)(f) does not specify a minimum number of days; requires only an 'organized educational program' in the nine subjects

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: No minimum hours specified in this subsection

requiredSubjects.notes: Must constitute an 'organized educational program' in these nine subjects

filings.notes: No notice, registration, or approval required under this pathway

recordRetention.notes: No record retention required by statute under this pathway

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: 180-day requirement cited in secondary sources for this pathway; verify against current MCL §380.1581 or related statute

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: Specific hour minimum not confirmed in fetched statute text

requiredSubjects.notes: Nonpublic school must provide instruction comparable to public schools; specific subject list for this pathway not confirmed in fetched sources

teacherQualification.value: Instructor must hold a bachelor's degree; religious objection exemption available per People v. DeJonge, 501 N.W.2d 127 (Mich. 1993)

evaluationOrTesting.notes: No testing requirement confirmed for this pathway in fetched sources

recordRetention.notes: Record retention requirements for nonpublic school pathway not confirmed in fetched sources

instructionDaysPerYear.notes: CGS §10-184 requires 'equivalent instruction' — a qualitative standard only; no minimum days codified

instructionHoursPerYear.notes: No minimum hours specified by statute; CT SDE recommends keeping an attendance log but does not mandate a minimum

value: citizenship including study of town, state, and federal governments
requiredSubjects.notes: CGS §10-184 enumerates these subjects; instruction method and materials are not mandated by statute

filings.notes: No Notice of Intent required by statute. CT SDE voluntary guidance suggests an optional NOI to the local superintendent within 10 days of starting, but this has no statutory basis and is not legally required.

evaluationOrTesting.notes: No testing, portfolio review, or curriculum approval required by statute. CT SDE recommends annual portfolio review and standardized testing as voluntary best practices only.

recordRetention.notes: No record retention required by statute. CT SDE recommends maintaining an attendance log and portfolio as voluntary guidance only.
